title: Access doors.
officialText:
Access doors shall be permitted in ceilings of fire-resistance-rated floor/ceiling and roof/ceil-
ing assemblies provided such doors are tested in accordance with ASTM E 119 or UL 263 as horizontal assemblies
and labeled by an approved agency for such purpose.
